step: 第1段-4 — tokenize のフラグをゲート化し、text 統計をテストにする
condition: text stream の裸 U+2581 比率がしきい値を超える dataset を CI が落とす。tokenize の全フラグが manifest の隣に記録され、後から参照できる。
finding: M3 が出荷した 4 つの parquet すべてが --no_whitespace_before_word なしで tokenize されている。tokenizer が実際に発行した text token のうち 44.6%〜46.6% が中身のない裸の U+2581 である。同じ台本を フラグ付きで tokenize し直すと 0.0% になる。

how_the_flag_was_established.method: Ran tokenize_and_pad_text over the shipped word transcripts twice - with and without the flag - and compared each result to the shipped tok-text .npz.
how_the_flag_was_established.what_it_also_proves: The byte-exact match pins --text_padding_id 3, --end_of_text_padding_id 0 and an effective audio_tokenizer_frame_rate of 12.5 as well: any other frame rate moves every token to a different frame index. In particular the 12 Hz rounding that tools/tokenize_text.py's type=int made possible did not happen in M3, because the flag was left at its default and argparse applies type= only to strings it parses from the command line.
how_the_flag_was_established.reproduce: uv run --no-sync --with sentencepiece --with numpy --with tqdm --with huggingface_hub python -m tools.text_stream_audit counterfactual --word_transcript_dir data/experiments/tsukuyomi_ojousama/m3/v-real/text --text_tokenizer_path <j-moshi-ext>/tokenizer_spm_32k_3.model

tokenizer.resolved_from: The three ids are looked up by piece and each lookup is confirmed by mapping the id back, so a tokenizer that does not hold the piece raises instead of counting the unknown id. None of them is hardcoded.

gate.definition: bare U+2581 / (bare U+2581 + words), per parquet per speaker, over the text row (row 0) that tools/prepare_dataset.merge_text_audio writes. Padding and end-of-text padding are excluded from the denominator: they come from the frame layout, not from the tokenizer, and the flag cannot change them. Measuring against non-pad instead reads 32.1% for the same parquet - a number that compares to nothing.
gate.applies_to: every parquet under data/experiments/tsukuyomi_ojousama/**/parquet/*.parquet that is not listed in quarantine
rationale: Every compliant measurement available sits at or below 0.036: 0.000 on this dataset's own transcripts re-tokenized with the flag, 0.036 on the verification's independent pyopenjtalk path.
Every non-compliant measurement sits at or above 0.4464.
0.1 is 2.8x the highest compliant value, which leaves room for a script that legitimately contains spaces - latin words, numerals, a quoted phrase - without going red.

0.1 is 4.5x below the lowest non-compliant value, so dropping the flag fails by a factor of four and a half rather than by a hair. A gate that only just catches the defect it was built for is a gate that will miss the next one.
It sits below the geometric mean of the two poles (0.127), i.e. deliberately biased toward catching the defect rather than toward passing.

It was not chosen to let anything existing through: passing the four shipped parquets would take a threshold above 0.466. They are quarantined by name instead, because a threshold raised until the candidate passes is indistinguishable from no threshold at all.

gate.why_an_empty_text_stream_is_not_a_pass: Three eval-prompt parquets emit no text tokens at all, so the ratio has a zero denominator. Returning 0.0 for them would report the cleanest possible result for an artifact the metric cannot see, and a training dataset that came out with an empty text stream would inherit that free pass. They are listed here instead, with a reason each, and the gate fails any other parquet whose text stream is empty.
gate.why_quarantine_rather_than_a_looser_thre: The gate has to be red for a flag-dropped dataset and green for the repository as it stands, and the four shipped parquets are flag-dropped. Loosening the threshold to 45% would satisfy the second requirement by abandoning the first. Naming the four paths satisfies both and costs something: a fifth path can only join them through a committed edit that states a reason and what supersedes it, which a reviewer sees. The test pins each quarantined share to the value recorded here, so the entries cannot quietly drift away from what they claim.

enforced_by.tests/test_experiment_assets.py::Tokeniz: Runs everywhere, standard library only. Every dialogue manifest must have a tokenize sidecar; every sidecar must state no_whitespace_before_word explicitly; a sidecar that states false must carry a known_defect block. This is the layer that catches the next dataset, because CI installs only pytest.
enforced_by.tests/test_experiment_assets.py::TextStr: Threshold-versus-poles and quarantine bookkeeping run everywhere. The parquet measurement runs where pandas, pyarrow, sentencepiece, the tokenizer and the gitignored data are all present - the machine that built the dataset - and skips elsewhere, the way RawCorpusIntegrityTests already skips absent audio.
